examples.text: Some New Yorkers are moving beyond the swipe to venture into flirtatious panel discussions and speed dating sessions.

examples.text: Owning a car in New York City is seen as a liability by many, especially when a quick Uber ride or the swipe of a MetroCard can easily get you where you need to go.

glosses: A rough guess; an estimate or swag.

examples.text: The politician took a swipe at his opponents.

examples.text: Woozy with swipe was the only way I could stay down with patience for work.
